metadata.scenario: A caller asks for information on the spa's operating hours and weekend availability. Category: General Information.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Harold Gonzalez. I hope you’re doing well! I’m calling to ask about your weekend availability. Hi Harold, I'm doing well, thank you! Our weekend hours are a bit different than during the week. Oh, I see. What are the specific hours for Saturday and Sunday? On Saturdays, we’re open from 8 AM to 5 PM. For Sundays, we’re only available for on-call emergencies. Got it, thanks. So, if I needed someone on a Sunday, I would have to call ahead? Yes, that’s correct. Just give us a call, and we’ll do our best to accommodate. Perfect! I really appreciate that. I’ve been needing frequent vital sign checks lately. Absolutely, we can coordinate those checks any weekday. Just let us know what times work best for you and your wife. Oh, that’s right—my wife needs to be there for all nursing visits. Understood, I’ll make a note that you prefer a Spanish-speaking caregiver as well. Thank you! That would be really helpful. Can you remind me how often you recommend those visits? Given your history with COPD and cardiac monitoring, I’d recommend at least once a week, but we can adjust based on your needs. That sounds reasonable. Is that something I can schedule now, or do I need to call back? I can schedule that for you right now. How about we look at next week? What day works best for you and your wife? Let’s go with Tuesday. What time would work for you? We have availability at 10 AM or 2 PM. Which one do you prefer? 10 AM would be great. Perfect! I’ll set that up for you and ensure a Spanish-speaking nurse is assigned. Thank you so much, Margaret. I appreciate your help! You’re welcome, Harold! Is there anything else I can assist you with today? No, that’s all for now. I’ll see you on Tuesday! Looking forward to it! Have a great day! You too, goodbye! Goodbye!
